title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1989-12-27
lineage: Fostex D-5 (AES/EBU)> Luminous Monarch cable> (s/pdif) M-Audio Audiophile 2496 @ 16/48> 16/44> CDWave(tracking)> TLH (SBE/Flac16/md5); Transferred and liberated to bt.etree on August 24, 2014 by jwpetty
source: Digital FOB by Lance Deal using Schoeps CMC 521's (FOB)> Schoeps VMS 52 UB> Technics SVMD1; Master DAT provided by Lance Deal;

ai_review.summary: Nice‑sounding audience recording featuring an unusually long Playin' jam, strong Brent keyboards and a wildly adventurous Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The show shines with a marathon Playin' in the Band that builds excitement, plus a soaring Bird Song and standout Brent’s keyboard work toward the end. The audience tape is generally clear and enjoyable, though the Morning Dew segment suffers from a partial loss of Jerry's guitar on some channels. Overall the performance outweighs the minor recording hiccup.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review praises the musical moments strongly while noting only a small channel‑loss issue, leading to an overall good rating but limited data for high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and lively overall, but Morning Dew has intermittent loss of Jerry's guitar in some channels, indicating a minor mix/recording glitch.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set stays solid, climaxing with an unusually long Playin' jam that drives the energy forward; Bird Song pushes the improvisational edge even higher before a brief dip in Morning Dew due to the guitar issue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar drops out on portions of Morning Dew, though it’s audible better here than other versions.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard playing is particularly strong toward the end of the show.
